text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four, two, two, three, 
four!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Well then, I'm heading out for a 
run—
Haaaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah! Isn't that—!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S?! Whoa, amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Her presence is really something else. The 
Nippon Derby was a close one, but she 
really feels like she's gonna achieve 
something big.

A robust build paired with impeccable 
physical ability. Above all, a sheer 
brilliance that stops people in their 
tracks—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Well, she's gotten even faster than when 
I saw her on the track before...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"If I recall, she's running in the Kobe 
Shimbun Hai. I wonder what she'll do after 
that. Will it be the Kikuka Sho after 
all...?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Judging by how things look, I 
wonder if there's a chance we might clash 
this year.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
In the Japan Cup, or the year-end Arima 
Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I have to hone that sensation I grasped 
at the Takarazuka Kinen over this 
summer...!"

Sensing the shadow of a new challenger, 
another heated "Summer Training Camp" has 
begun!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa! ...10 more to go...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Toh!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She is as hardworking as ever. However, as 
expected, the impact of another person's 
presence on psychological aspects and 
physical function is far greater than 
anticipated—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —However... ...Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"What about Cafe? After summer, it's the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, right?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“...... I've completed the menu. More 
importantly...... what about you......?”

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Coming all the way to the summer training 
camp... Are you really just here... to 
observe...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Of course! This place is a treasure trove 
of data, after all!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ... Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...You may already be aware of this, 
but... Regarding the leg condition... that 
often plagues racing Umamusume...――"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I hear that a new treatment... is 
currently being developed...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
As for the reason behind the indefinite 
hiatus... I don't know the full details, 
but... You, too—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Of course I read it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It takes immense perseverance and carries 
high risk. On top of that, considering the 
lost time over these past few years, Plan 
B is indeed the most efficient and 
rational choice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind who reaches the "Truth," and 
fortunately, my peers are all brilliant 
Umamusume. There is certainly no shortage 
of potential substitutes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Meaning there's no way I'm turning back 
now just to deal with all that hassle.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ………… Is that... so...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case... ...I won't stop you 
any longer.... However—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I am going to Longchamp... to see what 
it was you were seeking..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...With my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —It's about time you forgot about it too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, collection and verification! 
Summer has only just begun.

To seize a grand dream this autumn, summer 
training camp has begun once again!
